# Assets · Logos

6 files under `assets/Logos/`, held in the artifact’s asset store: fetch one with the Artifact tool’s `read`, the id below as `path` (they are not files beside the page — a read by file path fails), then upload it to your own artifact as an asset (`publish`, `asset:true`; or `upload_asset`, where your tool lists that); an SVG may also be inlined. Copy assets, never approximate them.

## Use

```html
<img src="<the url the asset upload returned for logo-payset.png>" alt="…">
```

## Usage notes

Payset wordmark and short marks, from the brand's own files.

- `payset-logo-full-green.svg`: money green (#256C4A) wordmark for cream and white grounds.
- `payset-logo-full-white.svg`: white wordmark for charcoal, money green, stone and photos.
- `payset-logo-short-white.svg`: white "p" mark on transparent, for dark grounds.
- `short-logo-money-dark.svg`, `payset-logo-short-money-green.png`: white "p" on a money-green square, for avatars, favicons and app icons.
- `logo-payset.png`: black wordmark on a light tile, sized to match the comparison logos.

Single-ink SVGs can't inherit colour through `<img>`: pick the file whose ink suits the ground.
